collection.name: formingGains
collection.doc: 🥫 Enhanced yield strength of a cold-formed member from the work hardening of the bends (EN 1993-1-3 3.2.2): process, ultimate strength of the base material, gross area and number of 90 degree bends with a small radius.

fields.name: member_id
fields.doc: 🥫 Id of the cold-formed member whose f_y is checked against the enhanced yield strength.

fields.name: forming
fields.doc: 🏭 Cold roll forming or other forming (brake pressing) selects the coefficient k of f_ya.

enum.name: FormingProcess
enum.doc: 🏭 Forming process of a cold-formed section: cold roll forming or other forming.

fields.name: ultimate_strength
fields.doc: 💪 Ultimate tensile strength of the base material before forming.

fields.name: gross_area
fields.doc: ▭ Gross cross-section area A_g of the member.

fields.name: bends
fields.doc: 🔢 Number of 90 degree bends with an inner radius r <= 5 t (bends of other angles count proportionally).
